names.l: Show mercy to someone today, in word or in deed.
Be gentle with someone who is weak or struggling.
Remember that every power you hold is only lent to you.
Keep your heart and your tongue clean today.
Say salam first, and leave peace behind you.
Keep your word and be someone people feel safe with.
Remember that He watches over all you do, even in secret.
Seek honour through obeying Him, not through people.
Ask Him to mend what is broken in you.
Be humble today; greatness belongs to Him alone.
Look at the sky or a tree and say Subhan Allah.
Thank Him for all He brought into being from nothing.
Thank Him for your face and body, and use them well.
Ask forgiveness for your sins, again and again.
Trust that nothing can overcome His decree.
Ask Him for a gift, then give a gift yourself.
Ask Him for provision, then work with honesty.
Ask Him to open a door that seems closed.
Ask Him for what you do not know, and learn something new.
Accept what is held back from you, and be patient.
Trust that relief from Him comes after tightness.
Do not envy; He lowers and raises as He wills.
Look down on no one; He raises whom He wills.
Seek honour only by pleasing Him.
Remember that arrogance ends in humiliation.
Be careful what you say; He hears every word.
Mind what you do when no one is watching.
Accept His judgement, and judge others fairly.
Be fair to everyone, even those you dislike.
Do a small kindness that nobody will notice.
Take your hidden worries to the One who knows them.
Do not rush to punish; be forbearing today.
Stand in awe of Him in your prayer.
Forgive someone who wronged you, as you hope to be forgiven.
Thank Allah, and thank people for small kindnesses.
Never let a matter feel too big for Him.
Say Allahu akbar, and let your worries grow small.
Ask Him to protect you, your family and your faith.
Be thankful for your food, and share some of it.
Count your own deeds before you are counted.
Respect what is great in His religion and His signs.
Be generous with your time, food and kind words.
Know that every moment is watched; do it well.
Make dua today, and be sure it is heard.
Ask Him boldly; His giving has no limit.
Trust His wisdom in what you do not understand.
Love someone for His sake, and tell them so.
Praise Him for His greatness and glorify Him.
Prepare for the day you will be raised.
Be truthful; He is witness to everything.
Hold to the truth even when it costs you.
Do your part, then rely on Him fully.
Ask Him for strength in your body and in your faith.
Stay firm on what is right, like a steady rock.
Choose friends who help you obey Him.
Praise Him in every state, and say Alhamdulillah.
Remember that every deed is counted.
Begin each task with Bismillah.
Remember that all things return to Him.
Ask Him to give life to a heart that has gone dead.
Remember death, and prepare for it.
Stay awake to the One who never sleeps.
Rely on the One who sustains all things.
Ask Him to find what you have lost.
Honour those who deserve honour; He is the Most Noble.
Worship Him alone, and put nothing before Him.
Keep your heart for Him alone.
Take every need to Him alone.
Remember that He can do what you cannot.
Fear no one's power but His.
Put first things first: pray, then plan.
Do not delay your repentance.
Begin the day by remembering Him.
End the day by remembering Him.
See His signs all around you.
Know that He sees even what is hidden in the heart.
Take Him as your protecting friend.
Raise your hands in dua; He is above all.
Be good to your parents, as He is good to you.
Repent today, and mean it.
Wrong no one; He takes the right of the wronged.
Pardon someone today, and say His dua for pardon.
Be kind to the people in your home.
Give up pride in what you own; it all belongs to Him.
Honour the one who deserves it: parents, elders, scholars.
Judge fairly, and give each person their due.
Bring together what has been divided: family, friends.
Be content with what He has given you.
Ask Him to free you from needing anyone but Him.
Accept what He holds back as His kindness.
Know that harm comes only by His leave; say Bismillah.
Ask for what benefits you, and help others to benefit.
Open the Qur'an and let its light guide you.
Ask Him to guide you, and guide someone yourself.
Marvel at His creation and say Subhan Allah.
Invest in what lasts: good deeds and knowledge.
Remember that all returns to Him; give in charity.

names.m: The Guide to the Right Way
names.l: Ask Him for the right decision before you act.
Be patient today with one thing you dislike.

ontime.label: Prayer on time
ontime.ar: أَىُّ الْعَمَلِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: الصَّلاَةُ عَلَى وَقْتِهَا.
ontime.en: The Prophet ﷺ was asked, “Which deed is most beloved to Allah?” He said, “Prayer at its proper time.”

jamaah.label: Prayer in congregation
jamaah.ar: صَلاَةُ الْجَمَاعَةِ تَفْضُلُ صَلاَةَ الْفَذِّ بِسَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً.
jamaah.en: “Prayer in congregation is twenty-seven degrees better than prayer offered alone.”

rawatib.label: The twelve sunnah rak'ahs
rawatib.ar: مَنْ صَلَّى اثْنَتَىْ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً فِي يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ، بُنِيَ لَهُ بِهِنَّ بَيْتٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ.
rawatib.en: “Whoever prays twelve rak'ahs in a day and a night, a house will be built for him in Paradise.” They are four before Dhuhr and two after it, two after Maghrib, two after 'Isha and two before Fajr.

fajr2.label: Two rak'ahs before Fajr
fajr2.ar: رَكْعَتَا الْفَجْرِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا.
fajr2.en: “The two rak'ahs of Fajr are better than this world and all that is in it.”

tasbih.label: Dhikr after each prayer
tasbih.ar: مَنْ سَبَّحَ اللَّهَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَكَبَّرَ اللَّهَ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، فَتِلْكَ تِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ، وَقَالَ تَمَامَ الْمِائَةِ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، غُفِرَتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ.
tasbih.en: “Whoever glorifies Allah thirty-three times after every prayer, praises Him thirty-three times and magnifies Him thirty-three times, that is ninety-nine, and completes the hundred with La ilaha illa Allah, wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, his sins are forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.”

adhkar.label: Morning and evening adhkar
adhkar.ar: مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ وَحِينَ يُمْسِي: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ، لَمْ يَأْتِ أَحَدٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِأَفْضَلَ مِمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ، إِلاَّ أَحَدٌ قَالَ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ أَوْ زَادَ عَلَيْهِ.
adhkar.en: “Whoever says Subhan Allahi wa bihamdih one hundred times in the morning and in the evening, no one will come on the Day of Resurrection with anything better, except one who said the same or more.”

quran.label: Qur'an every day
quran.ar: اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ، فَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ شَفِيعًا لأَصْحَابِهِ.
quran.en: “Recite the Qur'an, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor for its companions.”

duha.label: Duha prayer
duha.ar: أَوْصَانِي خَلِيلِي ﷺ بِثَلاَثٍ: صِيَامِ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ، وَرَكْعَتَىِ الضُّحَى، وَأَنْ أُوتِرَ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنَامَ.
duha.en: Abu Hurayrah said: “My close friend ﷺ advised me to do three things: to fast three days of every month, to pray the two rak'ahs of Duha, and to pray Witr before I sleep.”

witr.label: Witr
witr.en: “Make Witr the last of your prayer at night.”

qiyam.label: Night prayer
qiyam.ar: وَأَفْضَلُ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْفَرِيضَةِ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ.
qiyam.en: “The best prayer after the obligatory prayer is the night prayer.”

istighfar.label: Istighfar
istighfar.ar: وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً.
istighfar.en: “By Allah, I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day.”

salawat.label: Salawat on the Prophet ﷺ
salawat.ar: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَىَّ وَاحِدَةً، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا.
salawat.en: “Whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah sends blessings upon him ten times.”

sadaqah.label: Sadaqah, however small
sadaqah.ar: اتَّقُوا النَّارَ وَلَوْ بِشِقِّ تَمْرَةٍ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدْ فَبِكَلِمَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ.
sadaqah.en: “Protect yourselves from the Fire, even with half a date; and whoever does not find that, then with a kind word.”

kin.label: Parents and kin
kin.ar: مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَيُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ.
kin.en: “Whoever would like his provision to be increased and his life to be extended, let him keep the ties of kinship.”

tongue.label: Guarding the tongue
tongue.ar: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ، فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ.
tongue.en: “Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.”

siwak.label: Siwak
siwak.ar: لَوْلاَ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي ـ أَوْ عَلَى النَّاسِ ـ لأَمَرْتُهُمْ بِالسِّوَاكِ مَعَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
siwak.en: “Were it not that I would burden my ummah, or the people, I would have ordered them to use the siwak at every prayer.”

sleep.label: Sleeping with wudu, on the right side
sleep.ar: إِذَا أَتَيْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ فَتَوَضَّأْ وُضُوءَكَ لِلصَّلاَةِ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجِعْ عَلَى شِقِّكَ الأَيْمَنِ.
sleep.en: “When you go to your bed, perform wudu as you do for prayer, then lie down on your right side.”

kursi.label: Ayat al-Kursi before sleep
kursi.ar: إِذَا أَوَيْتَ إِلَى فِرَاشِكَ فَاقْرَأْ آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ {اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَىُّ الْقَيُّومُ} حَتَّى تَخْتِمَ الآيَةَ، فَإِنَّكَ لَنْ يَزَالَ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ حَافِظٌ وَلاَ يَقْرَبَنَّكَ شَيْطَانٌ حَتَّى تُصْبِحَ.
kursi.en: “When you go to your bed, recite Ayat al-Kursi. A guardian from Allah will remain over you, and no devil will come near you until morning.”

baqarah.label: The last two verses of al-Baqarah
baqarah.ar: مَنْ قَرَأَ بِالآيَتَيْنِ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، كَفَتَاهُ.
baqarah.en: “Whoever recites the last two verses of Surat al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.”

constant.label: Small and constant
constant.ar: أَحَبَّ الأَعْمَالِ أَدْوَمُهَا إِلَى اللَّهِ، وَإِنْ قَلَّ.
constant.en: “The most beloved of deeds to Allah are the most consistent of them, even if they are few.”

smile.label: A cheerful face
smile.ar: لاَ تَحْقِرَنَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرُوفِ شَيْئًا، وَلَوْ أَنْ تَلْقَى أَخَاكَ بِوَجْهٍ طَلْقٍ.
smile.en: “Do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.”

shukr.label: Gratitude and patience
shukr.ar: عَجَبًا لأَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ، إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ خَيْرٌ، وَلَيْسَ ذَاكَ لأَحَدٍ إِلاَّ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ، إِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ سَرَّاءُ شَكَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ، وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ ضَرَّاءُ صَبَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ.
shukr.en: “How wonderful is the affair of the believer, for all of his affair is good, and this is for no one but the believer. If something good happens to him he is grateful, and that is good for him. If hardship befalls him he is patient, and that is good for him.”

jumuah.label: Friday: ghusl, perfume, early and silent
jumuah.ar: لاَ يَغْتَسِلُ رَجُلٌ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، وَيَتَطَهَّرُ مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ طُهْرٍ، وَيَدَّهِنُ مِنْ دُهْنِهِ، أَوْ يَمَسُّ مِنْ طِيبِ بَيْتِهِ ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ، فَلاَ يُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي مَا كُتِبَ لَهُ، ثُمَّ يُنْصِتُ إِذَا تَكَلَّمَ الإِمَامُ، إِلاَّ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجُمُعَةِ الأُخْرَى.
jumuah.en: “Whoever takes a bath on Friday, purifies himself as much as he can, uses his oil or the perfume of his house, then goes out and does not separate two people, prays what is written for him and remains silent while the imam speaks, his sins between that Friday and the last are forgiven.”

kahf.label: Friday: Surat al-Kahf
kahf.ar: مَنْ قَرَأَ سُورَةَ الْكَهْفِ فِي يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ، أَضَاءَ لَهُ مِنَ النُّورِ مَا بَيْنَ الْجُمُعَتَيْنِ.
kahf.en: “Whoever recites Surat al-Kahf on Friday, a light will shine for him between the two Fridays.”
kahf.ref: al-Hakim and al-Bayhaqi; graded sahih by al-Albani

hour.label: Friday: the hour of response
hour.ar: فِيهِ سَاعَةٌ لاَ يُوَافِقُهَا عَبْدٌ مُسْلِمٌ، وَهْوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي، يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى شَيْئًا إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ.
hour.en: “On Friday there is an hour in which no Muslim stands praying and asks Allah for something, but He gives it to him.” Many scholars hold it is the last hour after 'Asr.

monthu.label: Fasting Monday and Thursday
monthu.ar: تُعْرَضُ الأَعْمَالُ يَوْمَ الاِثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسِ، فَأُحِبُّ أَنْ يُعْرَضَ عَمَلِي وَأَنَا صَائِمٌ.
monthu.en: “Deeds are presented on Monday and Thursday, and I love that my deeds are presented while I am fasting.”

white.label: Fasting the white days (13, 14, 15)
white.ar: يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ، إِذَا صُمْتَ مِنَ الشَّهْرِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، فَصُمْ ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ، وَأَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ، وَخَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ.
white.en: “If you fast three days of the month, then fast the thirteenth, fourteenth and fifteenth.”

ramadan.label: Fasting Ramadan
ramadan.ar: مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ.
ramadan.en: “Whoever fasts Ramadan with faith and hoping for reward, his previous sins are forgiven.”

taraweeh.label: Standing in prayer in Ramadan
taraweeh.ar: مَنْ قَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ.
taraweeh.en: “Whoever stands in prayer in Ramadan with faith and hoping for reward, his previous sins are forgiven.”

suhoor.label: Suhoor
suhoor.en: “Take suhoor, for in suhoor there is blessing.”

iftar.label: Breaking the fast without delay
iftar.ar: لاَ يَزَالُ النَّاسُ بِخَيْرٍ مَا عَجَّلُوا الْفِطْرَ.
iftar.en: “The people will remain upon goodness as long as they hasten to break the fast.”

qadr.label: Laylat al-Qadr
qadr.ar: تَحَرَّوْا لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فِي الْوِتْرِ مِنَ الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ.
qadr.en: “Seek Laylat al-Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten nights of Ramadan.” 'A'ishah asked what to say on it, and he taught her: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni. O Allah, You are Pardoning and love to pardon, so pardon me.

shawwal.label: Six days of Shawwal
shawwal.ar: مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَهُ سِتًّا مِنْ شَوَّالٍ، كَانَ كَصِيَامِ الدَّهْرِ.
shawwal.en: “Whoever fasts Ramadan and then follows it with six days of Shawwal, it is as if he fasted the whole year.”

tendays.label: The first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah
tendays.ar: مَا مِنْ أَيَّامٍ الْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ فِيهَا أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الأَيَّامِ.
tendays.en: “There are no days in which righteous deeds are more beloved to Allah than these days,” meaning the first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah.

arafah.label: Fasting 'Arafah and 'Ashura
arafah.ar: صِيَامُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ أَحْتَسِبُ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يُكَفِّرَ السَّنَةَ الَّتِي قَبْلَهُ، وَالسَّنَةَ الَّتِي بَعْدَهُ، وَصِيَامُ يَوْمِ عَاشُورَاءَ أَحْتَسِبُ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يُكَفِّرَ السَّنَةَ الَّتِي قَبْلَهُ.
arafah.en: “Fasting the day of 'Arafah, I hope from Allah that it expiates the year before it and the year after it. Fasting the day of 'Ashura, I hope from Allah that it expiates the year before it.”

tashriq.label: The days of Tashriq
tashriq.ar: أَيَّامُ التَّشْرِيقِ أَيَّامُ أَكْلٍ وَشُرْبٍ وَذِكْرٍ لِلَّهِ.
tashriq.en: “The days of Tashriq are days of eating, drinking and remembering Allah.” They are not fasted.

afuww.label: The dua of Laylat al-Qadr
afuww.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ، فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
afuww.en: O Allah, You are Pardoning and love to pardon, so pardon me.

firstaccount.label: The first thing asked about
firstaccount.ar: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ صَلاَتُهُ.
firstaccount.en: The first thing a servant will be called to account for on the Day of Resurrection is his prayer.

weekly.title: Begin with the intention
weekly.ar: إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى.
weekly.en: “Actions are only by intentions, and every person will have only what he intended.”
weekly.action: Before each task this week, pause and name who it is for.

weekly.title: The five pillars
weekly.ar: بُنِيَ الإِسْلاَمُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ: شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَإِقَامِ الصَّلاَةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَالْحَجِّ، وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ.
weekly.en: “Islam is built upon five: testifying that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing the prayer, giving zakah, the pilgrimage to the House, and fasting Ramadan.”
weekly.action: Choose the pillar you are weakest in and strengthen one part of it.

weekly.title: Leave what does not concern you
weekly.ar: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلاَمِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لاَ يَعْنِيهِ.
weekly.en: “Part of the excellence of a person's Islam is his leaving what does not concern him.”
weekly.action: Cut one source of idle talk or scrolling for seven days.

weekly.title: Love for your brother
weekly.ar: لا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ.
weekly.en: “None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.”
weekly.action: Make dua by name for someone who has what you wish for.

weekly.title: Do not become angry
weekly.ar: أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ: أَوْصِنِي. قَالَ: لاَ تَغْضَبْ. فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لاَ تَغْضَبْ.
weekly.en: A man said to the Prophet ﷺ, “Advise me.” He said, “Do not become angry.” The man repeated his request several times, and each time he said, “Do not become angry.”
weekly.action: When anger rises: seek refuge in Allah, be silent, change your posture.

weekly.title: The gates are opened
weekly.ar: إِذَا جَاءَ رَمَضَانُ فُتِّحَتْ أَبْوَابُ الْجَنَّةِ، وَغُلِّقَتْ أَبْوَابُ النَّارِ، وَصُفِّدَتِ الشَّيَاطِينُ.
weekly.en: “When Ramadan comes, the gates of Paradise are opened, the gates of the Fire are closed, and the devils are chained.”
weekly.action: Prepare: settle debts of fasting, plan your Qur'an, clear your schedule.

weekly.title: Fasting is for Allah
weekly.ar: كُلُّ عَمَلِ ابْنِ آدَمَ لَهُ إِلاَّ الصِّيَامَ، فَإِنَّهُ لِي، وَأَنَا أَجْزِي بِهِ، وَالصِّيَامُ جُنَّةٌ.
weekly.en: Allah said: “Every deed of the son of Adam is for him, except fasting. It is for Me, and I shall reward for it.” Fasting is a shield. The fasting person has two joys: one when he breaks his fast, and one when he meets his Lord.
weekly.action: Guard the fast of the eyes, ears and tongue along with the stomach.

weekly.title: More than hunger
weekly.ar: مَنْ لَمْ يَدَعْ قَوْلَ الزُّورِ وَالْعَمَلَ بِهِ فَلَيْسَ لِلَّهِ حَاجَةٌ فِي أَنْ يَدَعَ طَعَامَهُ وَشَرَابَهُ.
weekly.en: “Whoever does not give up false speech and acting upon it, Allah has no need of his giving up his food and drink.”
weekly.action: No lying, no backbiting, no arguing. If provoked say: I am fasting.

weekly.title: The most generous of people
weekly.ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَجْوَدَ النَّاسِ، وَكَانَ أَجْوَدُ مَا يَكُونُ فِي رَمَضَانَ حِينَ يَلْقَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ، وَكَانَ يَلْقَاهُ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فَيُدَارِسُهُ الْقُرْآنَ.
weekly.en: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was the most generous of people, and he was most generous in Ramadan when Jibril met him. Jibril would meet him every night of Ramadan and review the Qur'an with him.”
weekly.action: Give something every day this week, and review Qur'an with a companion.

weekly.title: Seek the Night of Decree
weekly.ar: مَنْ قَامَ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ.
weekly.en: “Whoever stands in prayer on Laylat al-Qadr with faith and hoping for reward, his previous sins are forgiven.”
weekly.action: Treat every one of the last ten nights as if it were the night.

weekly.title: Follow it with six
weekly.ar: مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَهُ سِتًّا مِنْ شَوَّالٍ، كَانَ كَصِيَامِ الدَّهْرِ.
weekly.en: “Whoever fasts Ramadan and then follows it with six days of Shawwal, it is as if he fasted the whole year.”
weekly.action: Keep one Ramadan habit alive, and plan your six days of Shawwal.

weekly.title: Taqwa wherever you are
weekly.ar: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ.
weekly.en: “Fear Allah wherever you are, follow a bad deed with a good deed and it will wipe it out, and treat people with good character.”
weekly.action: After any slip this week, follow it at once with a good deed.

weekly.title: Be mindful of Allah
weekly.ar: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ، إِذَا سَأَلْتَ فَاسْأَلِ اللَّهَ، وَإِذَا اسْتَعَنْتَ فَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ.
weekly.en: “Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah and you will find Him before you. When you ask, ask Allah. When you seek help, seek help from Allah.”
weekly.action: Take your need to Allah in sujud before you take it to anyone else.

weekly.title: Leave what makes you doubt
weekly.ar: دَعْ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَى مَا لاَ يَرِيبُكَ.
weekly.en: “Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.”
weekly.action: Drop one doubtful thing from your income, food or habits.

weekly.title: Purity is half of faith
weekly.ar: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلآنِ - أَوْ تَمْلأُ - مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، وَالصَّلاَةُ نُورٌ، وَالصَّدَقَةُ بُرْهَانٌ، وَالصَّبْرُ ضِيَاءٌ، وَالْقُرْآنُ حُجَّةٌ لَكَ أَوْ عَلَيْكَ.
weekly.en: “Purity is half of faith. Alhamdulillah fills the scale. Subhan Allah wal-hamdulillah fill what is between the heavens and the earth. Prayer is light, charity is proof, patience is illumination, and the Qur'an is a proof for you or against you.”
weekly.action: Stay in wudu as much as you can, and renew it with care.

weekly.title: A traveller in this world
weekly.ar: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ، أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ.
weekly.en: “Be in this world as though you were a stranger or a traveller.”
weekly.action: Give away something you own but do not need.

weekly.title: Excellence in everything
weekly.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ الإِحْسَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ.
weekly.en: “Allah has prescribed excellence in all things.”
weekly.action: Pick one ordinary task and do it with ihsan from start to finish.

weekly.title: The strong believer
weekly.ar: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ، احْرِصْ عَلَى مَا يَنْفَعُكَ، وَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ، وَلاَ تَعْجِزْ.
weekly.en: “The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and in both there is good. Strive for what benefits you, seek the help of Allah, and do not give up.”
weekly.action: Build strength: one habit for the body, one for the heart.

weekly.title: The ten best days
weekly.ar: مَا مِنْ أَيَّامٍ الْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ فِيهَا أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الأَيَّامِ.
weekly.en: “There are no days in which righteous deeds are more beloved to Allah than these days,” meaning the first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah.
weekly.action: Fill the ten days with takbir, fasting, charity and Qur'an.

weekly.title: Two blessings
weekly.ar: نِعْمَتَانِ مَغْبُونٌ فِيهِمَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، الصِّحَّةُ وَالْفَرَاغُ.
weekly.en: “There are two blessings which many people lose out on: health and free time.”
weekly.action: Give your best free hour this week to something that outlives you.

weekly.title: True strength
weekly.ar: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ.
weekly.en: “The strong man is not the one who overpowers others. The strong man is the one who controls himself when he is angry.”
weekly.action: Win one argument this week by not having it.

weekly.title: Safe from your tongue and hand
weekly.ar: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ.
weekly.en: “The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.”
weekly.action: No message, comment or word that harms a Muslim.

weekly.title: Make things easy
weekly.ar: يَسِّرُوا وَلاَ تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلاَ تُنَفِّرُوا.
weekly.en: “Make things easy and do not make them difficult. Give glad tidings and do not drive people away.”
weekly.action: Make one thing easier for someone at home or at work.

weekly.title: The path of knowledge
weekly.ar: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا، سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ.
weekly.en: “Whoever treads a path seeking knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise.”
weekly.action: Fix a time for one lesson or one chapter, and attend it.

weekly.title: The best of you
weekly.ar: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ.
weekly.en: “The best of you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.”
weekly.action: Learn one new ayah with its meaning and teach it to someone.

weekly.title: Two rewards
weekly.ar: الْمَاهِرُ بِالْقُرْآنِ مَعَ السَّفَرَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْبَرَرَةِ، وَالَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَيَتَتَعْتَعُ فِيهِ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِ شَاقٌّ، لَهُ أَجْرَانِ.
weekly.en: “The one who is skilled in the Qur'an is with the noble, righteous scribes. The one who recites it and stumbles over it, finding it difficult, has two rewards.”
weekly.action: Read aloud every day, however slowly.

weekly.title: Three that continue
weekly.ar: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: إِلاَّ مِنْ صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ.
weekly.en: “When a person dies his deeds come to an end, except for three: ongoing charity, knowledge that is benefited from, or a righteous child who prays for him.”
weekly.action: Start one deed that will keep working after you.

weekly.title: Charity does not decrease wealth
weekly.ar: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا، وَمَا تَوَاضَعَ أَحَدٌ لِلَّهِ إِلاَّ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ.
weekly.en: “Charity does not decrease wealth. Allah increases a servant in honour when he forgives. No one humbles himself for Allah except that Allah raises him.”
weekly.action: Give, forgive and step back, once each.

weekly.title: One body
weekly.ar: مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَوَادِّهِمْ وَتَرَاحُمِهِمْ وَتَعَاطُفِهِمْ مَثَلُ الْجَسَدِ، إِذَا اشْتَكَى مِنْهُ عُضْوٌ تَدَاعَى لَهُ سَائِرُ الْجَسَدِ بِالسَّهَرِ وَالْحُمَّى.
weekly.en: “The believers, in their mutual love, mercy and compassion, are like one body. When one limb aches, the whole body responds with sleeplessness and fever.”
weekly.action: Visit, call or support a Muslim who is in hardship.

weekly.title: Hearts and deeds
weekly.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ، وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ.
weekly.en: “Allah does not look at your appearance or your wealth. He looks at your hearts and your deeds.”
weekly.action: Do one good deed that no one will ever know about.

weekly.title: Best in character
weekly.ar: أَكْمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحْسَنُهُمْ خُلُقًا، وَخِيَارُكُمْ خِيَارُكُمْ لِنِسَائِهِمْ خُلُقًا.
weekly.en: “The most complete of the believers in faith are those with the best character, and the best of you are those who are best to their wives.”
weekly.action: Be at your gentlest with the people of your own home.

weekly.title: Best to his family
weekly.ar: خَيْرُكُمْ خَيْرُكُمْ لأَهْلِهِ، وَأَنَا خَيْرُكُمْ لأَهْلِي.
weekly.en: “The best of you is the one who is best to his family, and I am the best of you to my family.”
weekly.action: Serve your family with your own hands this week.

weekly.title: Mercy to the young, honour to the old
weekly.ar: لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَرْحَمْ صَغِيرَنَا وَيُوَقِّرْ كَبِيرَنَا.
weekly.en: “He is not one of us who does not show mercy to our young and respect to our elders.”
weekly.action: Give a child your full attention and an elder your time.

weekly.title: The merciful are shown mercy
weekly.ar: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ.
weekly.en: “The merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on the earth, and the One above the heavens will have mercy upon you.”
weekly.action: Show mercy to a person, an animal and yourself.

weekly.title: Your mother
weekly.ar: مَنْ أَحَقُّ بِحُسْنِ صَحَابَتِي؟ قَالَ: أُمُّكَ. قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: أُمُّكَ. قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: أُمُّكَ. قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: ثُمَّ أَبُوكَ.
weekly.en: A man asked, “O Messenger of Allah, who is most deserving of my good company?” He said, “Your mother.” He asked, “Then who?” He said, “Your mother.” He asked, “Then who?” He said, “Your mother.” He asked, “Then who?” He said, “Your father.”
weekly.action: Honour your parents: a call, a gift, a service, or dua if they have passed.

weekly.title: The neighbour
weekly.ar: مَا زَالَ يُوصِينِي جِبْرِيلُ بِالْجَارِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ سَيُوَرِّثُهُ.
weekly.en: “Jibril kept advising me about the neighbour until I thought he would make him an heir.”
weekly.action: Greet a neighbour and share food with one.

weekly.title: Every kindness is charity
weekly.ar: كُلُّ مَعْرُوفٍ صَدَقَةٌ.
weekly.en: “Every act of kindness is charity.”
weekly.action: Count seven small kindnesses, one for each day.

weekly.title: The branches of faith
weekly.ar: الإِيمَانُ بِضْعٌ وَسَبْعُونَ أَوْ بِضْعٌ وَسِتُّونَ شُعْبَةً، فَأَفْضَلُهَا قَوْلُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَأَدْنَاهَا إِمَاطَةُ الأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ، وَالْحَيَاءُ شُعْبَةٌ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ.
weekly.en: “Faith has seventy-odd, or sixty-odd, branches. The highest is saying La ilaha illa Allah, the lowest is removing something harmful from the path, and modesty is a branch of faith.”
weekly.action: Remove a harm from someone's path, in the street or in life.

weekly.title: Truthfulness
weekly.ar: إِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ، وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ، وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَصْدُقُ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ صِدِّيقًا.
weekly.en: “Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. A man keeps telling the truth until he is written with Allah as truthful.”
weekly.action: Tell the whole truth, including in jokes and excuses.

weekly.title: Three signs
weekly.ar: آيَةُ الْمُنَافِقِ ثَلاَثٌ: إِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ، وَإِذَا وَعَدَ أَخْلَفَ، وَإِذَا اؤْتُمِنَ خَانَ.
weekly.en: “The signs of the hypocrite are three: when he speaks he lies, when he promises he breaks it, and when he is trusted he betrays.”
weekly.action: Keep every promise and return every trust, however small.

weekly.title: Beware of suspicion
weekly.ar: إِيَّاكُمْ وَالظَّنَّ، فَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ أَكْذَبُ الْحَدِيثِ، وَلاَ تَحَسَّسُوا، وَلاَ تَجَسَّسُوا، وَلاَ تَحَاسَدُوا، وَلاَ تَدَابَرُوا، وَلاَ تَبَاغَضُوا، وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا.
weekly.en: “Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most false of speech. Do not pry, do not spy, do not envy one another, do not turn your backs on one another, do not hate one another. Be servants of Allah, as brothers.”
weekly.action: Give seventy excuses before you believe one bad thought.

weekly.title: What backbiting is
weekly.ar: أَتَدْرُونَ مَا الْغِيبَةُ؟ قَالُوا: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ. قَالَ: ذِكْرُكَ أَخَاكَ بِمَا يَكْرَهُ.
weekly.en: “Do you know what backbiting is? It is to mention your brother with what he dislikes.”
weekly.action: Leave any gathering or chat the moment someone absent is discussed.

weekly.title: Gentleness
weekly.ar: إِنَّ الرِّفْقَ لاَ يَكُونُ فِي شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ زَانَهُ، وَلاَ يُنْزَعُ مِنْ شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ شَانَهُ.
weekly.en: “Gentleness is not found in anything except that it beautifies it, and it is not removed from anything except that it makes it ugly.”
weekly.action: Lower your voice and soften your words in every correction.

weekly.title: Even the prick of a thorn
weekly.ar: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ هَمٍّ وَلاَ حُزْنٍ وَلاَ أَذًى وَلاَ غَمٍّ حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا، إِلاَّ كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ.
weekly.en: “No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, harm or distress befalls a Muslim, even the prick of a thorn, except that Allah expiates some of his sins by it.”
weekly.narrator: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and Abu Hurayrah
weekly.action: Meet one hardship this week with Alhamdulillah and patience.

weekly.title: Look at those below you
weekly.ar: انْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ، وَلاَ تَنْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ فَوْقَكُمْ، فَهُوَ أَجْدَرُ أَنْ لاَ تَزْدَرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ.
weekly.en: “Look at those who are below you and do not look at those who are above you, so that you do not belittle the favours of Allah upon you.”
weekly.action: Write ten blessings you have never thanked Allah for.

weekly.title: True richness
weekly.ar: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ.
weekly.en: “Richness is not in having many possessions. True richness is the richness of the soul.”
weekly.action: Buy nothing you do not need for seven days.

weekly.title: The work of your hand
weekly.ar: مَا أَكَلَ أَحَدٌ طَعَامًا قَطُّ خَيْرًا مِنْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ.
weekly.en: “No one has ever eaten better food than what he eats from the work of his own hand.”
weekly.action: Work with honesty and ask Allah for halal, blessed provision.

weekly.title: Easy in buying and selling
weekly.ar: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ رَجُلاً سَمْحًا إِذَا بَاعَ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى، وَإِذَا اقْتَضَى.
weekly.en: “May Allah have mercy on a man who is easygoing when he sells, when he buys and when he asks for payment.”
weekly.action: Be generous in a deal, and give time to someone who owes you.

weekly.title: As the birds are provided for
weekly.ar: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ، لَرُزِقْتُمْ كَمَا تُرْزَقُ الطَّيْرُ، تَغْدُو خِمَاصًا وَتَرُوحُ بِطَانًا.
weekly.en: “If you were to rely upon Allah as He should be relied upon, He would provide for you as He provides for the birds. They go out hungry in the morning and return full in the evening.”
weekly.action: Do your part fully, then leave the result to Allah.

weekly.title: As My servant thinks of Me
weekly.ar: أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي، وَأَنَا مَعَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَنِي.
weekly.en: Allah says: “I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me.”
weekly.action: Make dua this week with certainty that you are heard.

weekly.title: The living and the dead
weekly.ar: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ، مَثَلُ الْحَىِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ.
weekly.en: “The example of the one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not is like the living and the dead.”
weekly.action: Fill your waiting time with dhikr: queues, travel, chores.

weekly.title: Two words
weekly.ar: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
weekly.en: “Two words are light on the tongue, heavy in the scale and beloved to the Most Merciful: Subhan Allahi wa bihamdih, Subhan Allahil-'Azim.”
weekly.action: Say them a hundred times each day.

weekly.title: The last third of the night
weekly.ar: يَنْزِلُ رَبُّنَا تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا، حِينَ يَبْقَى ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرُ يَقُولُ: مَنْ يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ، مَنْ يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ، مَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ.
weekly.en: “Our Lord descends every night to the lowest heaven when the last third of the night remains, and says: Who is calling upon Me, that I may answer him? Who is asking of Me, that I may give him? Who is seeking My forgiveness, that I may forgive him?”
weekly.action: Rise before Fajr at least twice, even for two rak'ahs.

weekly.title: The best of those who err
weekly.ar: كُلُّ ابْنِ آدَمَ خَطَّاءٌ، وَخَيْرُ الْخَطَّائِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ.
weekly.en: “Every son of Adam errs, and the best of those who err are those who repent.”
weekly.action: Name one sin, leave it, regret it, and resolve not to return.

weekly.title: Asked about four
weekly.ar: لاَ تَزُولُ قَدَمَا عَبْدٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يُسْأَلَ عَنْ عُمْرِهِ فِيمَا أَفْنَاهُ، وَعَنْ عِلْمِهِ فِيمَا فَعَلَ، وَعَنْ مَالِهِ مِنْ أَيْنَ اكْتَسَبَهُ وَفِيمَا أَنْفَقَهُ، وَعَنْ جِسْمِهِ فِيمَا أَبْلاَهُ.
weekly.en: “The feet of a servant will not move on the Day of Resurrection until he is asked about his life and how he spent it, his knowledge and what he did with it, his wealth, from where he earned it and on what he spent it, and his body and how he used it.”
weekly.action: Answer the four questions in writing, honestly.

weekly.title: Guide to good
weekly.ar: مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَى خَيْرٍ فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ فَاعِلِهِ.
weekly.en: “Whoever guides to something good has a reward like that of the one who does it.”
weekly.action: Share one benefit you learned this year with someone who needs it.

weekly.title: Deeds are by their endings
weekly.ar: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالْخَوَاتِيمِ.
weekly.en: “Deeds are only judged by their endings.”
weekly.action: End the year well: repent, forgive, settle what you owe, and renew your intention.

sunnah.t: Begin with the right: wudu, dressing, combing, entering the home.
Say Bismillah and eat with your right hand, from what is near you.
Greet people you know and people you do not know.
Meet people with a cheerful face.
Use the siwak before each prayer.
Pray two rak'ahs when you enter a masjid.
Say the dua of leaving home: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'ala Allah.
Greet your family with salam when you enter your home.
Visit someone who is sick.
Say Alhamdulillah when you sneeze, and Yarhamukallah to one who does.
Repeat after the caller to prayer, then send salawat and make dua.
Make dua between the adhan and the iqamah.
Walk to the prayer calmly, with dignity.
Pray some of your voluntary prayers at home.
After Fajr, stay in dhikr until sunrise, then pray two rak'ahs.
Pray two rak'ahs after every wudu.
Recite Ikhlas, Falaq and Nas three times, morning and evening.
Say La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, a treasure of Paradise.
Say Subhan Allahi wa bihamdihi a hundred times.
Send salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ.
Make dua for your brother in his absence.
Give a gift, and accept gifts.
Remove something harmful from the path.
Give water to someone who is thirsty.
Plant a tree or sow a seed.
Feed a fasting person at iftar.
Make peace between two people who have fallen out.
Cover a Muslim's fault instead of exposing it.
Be kind to an orphan.
Be generous to your neighbour.
Please your parents; Allah's pleasure is in theirs.
Keep the ties of kinship, and do not cut them.
Give sadaqah in secret.
Recite the Qur'an in a beautiful voice.
Visit the graves to remember the Hereafter.
Pray over the dead and follow the funeral.
Be clean and well-presented; Allah is beautiful and loves beauty.
Keep the acts of the fitrah: trim nails, clip the moustache, remove hair.
Eat dates; a home without dates goes hungry.
Drink sitting, and in three breaths.
Praise Allah after your food and drink.
Say: Ya Muqallib al-qulub, thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik.
Sleep with the dua: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.
Pray at night while people sleep.
When angry, sit down; if it persists, lie down.
When angry, say A'udhu billahi min ash-shaytan ir-rajim.
Say: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan.
Honour the elderly Muslim.
After wudu, say the shahadah; the eight gates of Paradise open.
Pray two rak'ahs of Duha as sadaqah for your joints.
Say Amin when the imam says it.
Treat people as you would like to be treated.
End each gathering: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika...

months.ayah: Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves.
The month of Ramadan in which the Qur'an was revealed, a guidance for mankind and clear proofs of guidance and the criterion.
If you are grateful, I will surely increase you.
So when you have finished, then stand up for worship, and to your Lord direct your longing.
Say: Indeed my prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
Whoever emigrates for the cause of Allah will find on the earth many places of refuge and abundance.
Whoever relies upon Allah, He is sufficient for him.
There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allah an excellent example.
And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
O you who believe, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
Truly, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
O you who believe, fear Allah, and let every soul look to what it has sent forth for tomorrow.

namesHadith.ar: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ اسْمَا، مِائَةً إِلاَّ وَاحِدًا، مَنْ أَحْصَاهَا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ.
namesHadith.en: Allah has ninety-nine names, one hundred less one. Whoever preserves them will enter Paradise.
